name: Anthion's Old Friend
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Theldren is not one to willingly participate in a fair fight.  I've shaped this banner to display his family colors.

With some additional sorcery, this banner shall provoke him in a way he won't be able to resist.

An old acquaintance of mine named Falrin knows the exact procedure required.  He has a particular way of... aggravating people.  You shall find him at the library in Dire Maul.
narrative.objectives: Take the incomplete Banner of Provocation to Falrin Treeshaper at the library in Dire Maul.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Anthion sent you, you say? I thought he was dead. I guess I've heard stranger things in my life.

Very well, then.  What is it you want me to do with this banner?
narrative.requestItemsText: Speak up stranger, can't you see I'm busy?

quests.name: Falrin's Vendetta
quests.objectiveText: Collect 25 Ogre Warbeads from Ogres inside Dire Maul or Blackrock Spire and return to Falrin Treeshaper inside the Athenaeum in Dire Maul.

quests.name: The Instigator's Enchantment
quests.objectiveText: Bring the following to Falrin Treeshaper inside Dire Maul: 1 Jeering Spectre's Essence, 4 Dark Runes and 8 Large Brilliant Shards.

quests.name: The Challenge
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths and place the Banner of Provocation in its center as you are sentenced by High Justice Grimstone.
